main_text.p: extulit: Item Suspendit, crucifixit, quomodo semper Syriacè significat, unico loco 2.ad Tim.4.15.excepto, ubi priorem significationem retinet. Ithpeh. Erigi, elevari, exaltari, attolli, suspendi, crucifigi. Ex Aphel Evexisti, extulisti me, Psalm.30.2.
Ch.& Syr. Crux, patibulum. Esth.6.4. in T.“ec. Item Erectio, Surrectio, Thren.3.63.
Ch. Mundare, purgare, expurgare. Pahel Idem. Part. Pyh. ex forma Heb. Purgatu, Cant.1.11, pro .
Necesse esse, opus habere: Et ego necesse habeo, Genes.30.30. in Targ. Jon.
Ch. Purus, purum, mundum, purgatum: Plural. Cant.1.11. Fœm. Pura, Psal.68.31.
Syr. Texere, contexere. Hinc Pehil fœm.
Ch. Cingere, Accingere, expedire, munire, armare, sternere, insternere equum vel asinum: Admonere, excitare, incitare, festinare, urgere: Ite Accinctum esse, accingi, accingere se. Pahel Idem.

page.notes: Hebrew and Syriac words are printed in Hebrew/Syriac letters and are only approximated or omitted here; the Hebrew characters could not be reliably reproduced. Lines marked by small Hebrew forms are illegible in this transcription.
